scope: Lung-development-relevant datasets and tracks bearing on the NKX2-1 -> SOX2/SOX9 -> FGF10/WNT/BMP/SHH -> airway/alveolar regulatory axis.
curation_method: human-curated; entries are pointers, not validated accessions. Every entry must be re-checked against its source portal before being relied on for analysis.

sources.notes: Sikkema et al. 2023 Nat Med; ~2.4M cells, ~486 donors; integrated with scANVI. Query: tissue_general=='lung' filtered to HLCA core dataset_ids.
Disease-extended HLCA; useful as a contrast to development but not the primary developmental signal.

sources.dataset_name: Pan-fetal human cell atlas (Cao et al. 2020)
sources.notes: Cao et al. 2020 Science; fetal cell atlas. Lung subset gives proximal/distal progenitor coverage. Verify the dataset is currently indexed in Census before relying on it.

sources.dataset_name: Human fetal lung atlas (He et al. 2022)
sources.notes: He et al. 2022 Nat Genet; fetal lung scRNA-seq with spatial. Verify Census coverage; if absent, fall back to the paper's GEO accession.
Project-level metadata + downloadable matrix files. Verify the LungMAP-specific Azul base URL at use time.
Mouse comparator across the same developmental stages; useful for cross-species validation of regulator-target predictions.
Use as an editorial cross-check against Census-derived marker gene lists.

sources.dataset_name: Lung tissue TF ChIP-seq (all TFs in lung biosamples)
sources.notes: Verified 2026-05-03 via gain_verify.py: 6 experiments total (EP300 mouse P0; CTCF mouse P0/E14.5/adult and human adult; POLR2A mouse adult). DOCUMENTED GAP: NKX2-1, SOX2, SOX9 ChIP-seq do not exist anywhere in ENCODE in any biosample (target.label queries return zero hits). For lung-developmental TF binding inference, accessibility + motif scanning is required.

Verified 2026-05-03: 59 experiments. Indirect regulatory signal: marks active promoters/enhancers (H3K4me3, H3K27ac, etc.), not TF identity. Pair with ATAC-seq + motif scanning to infer specific TF binding.
Verified 2026-05-03: 5 experiments. Sparse but the canonical accessibility assay; use with motif-scanning (e.g., JASPAR) to infer TF binding when direct ChIP is missing.
Verified 2026-05-03: 30 experiments. Older ENCODE accessibility assay; complementary to ATAC-seq for inferring open regulatory regions in lung biosamples.

sources.dataset_name: Candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) - human lung biosamples
sources.access_method: Web UI + GraphQL API + bulk files
sources.notes: Defer to v1.x. Verifier returned 429 on 2026-05-03 (bot detection / rate limit). Either switch to documented GraphQL endpoint with appropriate headers, or back off and try a different entry. Used for marker-to-regulator linker MVP.
